notes: State part only. About 110 Alaska cities and boroughs levy their own sales taxes (1% to 7%), each deciding its own exemptions ('For information on what is not taxable, contact the municipality directly', DCCED Sales Tax page), so AK:local is left unresearched: no general treatment can be stated. Source is the Department of Commerce, Community and Economic Development (a state agency; its pages block automated fetches, so dated Wayback snapshots are cited); no Department of Revenue page stating this was found. The Alaska Remote Seller Sales Tax Commission's uniform code (an intergovernmental body of member municipalities) was not used. Earliest verified: the State Assessor's page said the same on 2017-01-05.
